items.title: Edward "Kid" Ory Interview, 1957-04-20
items.q: Buddy what? Bottler. Bottler. Buddy Bottler. How do you spell his name? B-O-T-T-L-E-Y, Bottler. Bottler. Buddy Bottler. Didn't somebody say Buddy Bowler went up and blows? No, no. That's Bottler.

ctx.x: He was a promoter at Lincoln Gardens.

Yeah. Buddy what? Bottler. Bottler. Buddy Bottler. How do you spell his name? B-O-T-T-L-E-Y, Bottler. Bottler. Buddy Bottler. Didn't somebody say Buddy Bowler went up and blows? No, no. That's Bottler.
His name's got confused. This is the guy, this is the guy. The promoter at the park where Bolden was playing at that time. I see. He's the guy, yeah.
